input_extraction: Archived all-A arrays[:,10:10+length], once, then (ASCII-65)/25. Original AAAAAA start and absolute pin labels.
metric: 100 * correct individual pin predictions / (26 * 102976); NumPy round-to-even at 0.5.
model_source: Published notebook #4, model definition retained; each length uses its own published model and training hyperparameters.
pin_scope: All 26 wheel-1 pins explicitly included, one ten-epoch model per pin at each length.
training_pool: The original archived training pool; first rows from 100 sampled complete-size archive pairs per attempt. Ten incomplete-size pairs are excluded. No new keys generated.
checkpoint_selection: Final epoch. Validation-best checkpoints retained separately.
external_test_role: Scored after training; never used for checkpoint or model selection.
retained_artifacts: Weights, predictions and detailed logs are retained locally; large binary artifacts are not included in this PR.
